svg.title: DCGAN
svg.desc: Original conceptual schematic. Generator learns upsampling with transposed convolutions, BN/ReLU and Tanh output; discriminator uses strided convolutions and LeakyReLU. Not a reproduction of a paper figure. MIT.

g.text: Convolutional synthesis and learned strided downsampling
BN omitted at the generator output and discriminator input; no deterministic pooling.
Concept schematic · implementation details omitted · original artwork / MIT
